propositions: Commit 40b8ac8295 eagerly loads runtime.py at reconcile.py:94-96 on every bridge pass, but runtime.py:39 imports pydantic.SecretStr at module scope while the bridge installs core without [agents] extra, causing ModuleNotFoundError
The engine/reconciler must remain stdlib-only per pyproject.toml and docs/config.md contract, and pydantic is declared only in the optional agents extra

test_core_optionality.py::test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack verifies the packaged reconciler runtime loads without Pydantic present and that credentials are absent from repr/equality/hash

StaticAuth.secret was replaced with a frozen stdlib string field with repr=False and compare=False, preserving exact token delivery at call boundaries while eliminating the undeclared import prerequisite
A fresh no-extras install successfully imports rebar_reconciler.runtime and the scheduled bridge run 32155185851 completed successfully, clearing the CloudWatch alarm
